title: JSFL: showGrid/showGuides properties missing from JsflTimeline
description: The JsflTimeline interface in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts (line 403+) lacks showGrid and showGuides properties. The model has docProperties.grid.showGrid and guides data. Fix: add showGrid: boolean and showGuides: boolean as get/set properties to JsflTimeline interface and makeTimelineProxy. Getter reads from doc.properties.grid.showGrid (or similar path). Setter updates it via pushDoc with a mutated doc.properties. Check how docProperties.grid is structured in the model types.
